context: Tests CliAIAgent for subscription-backed, cross-vendor review composed into a graph. The constraint 'there is no API key and there will not be one' is the whole point: solutions that add an Anthropic PromptExecutor ignore it. The fail-closed requirement is stated explicitly in the task and maps to structuredResult being nullable.

checklist.name: Uses CliAIAgent.claude with outputClass
checklist.description: Constructs the reviewer via CliAIAgent.claude(..., outputClass = Critique::class, ...) to get a typed CliAgentStructuredResponse<Critique>. Does NOT add an Anthropic PromptExecutor or AnthropicLLMClient — the task states no API key exists, so any API-key-based solution fails the requirement outright

checklist.name: apiKey is null, and says why
checklist.description: Leaves apiKey null (or omits it) and identifies that this is what makes the CLI use its own subscription login. Passing a key sets ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the child environment and overrides the subscription — the opposite of what was asked

checklist.name: Fails closed on a null critique
checklist.description: Branches with structuredResult?.approved == true for the approval edge, so a null (crashed, timed out, or unparseable) reviewer routes to rejection. Using !=false, !!, or assuming non-null approves on failure and violates the explicit requirement

checklist.name: Composes with asNode and imports it
checklist.description: Wires the agent into the strategy with .asNode(), including the ai.koog.agents.cli.asNode import — asNode is an extension function and the code does not compile without it

checklist.name: agents-cli on the beta version line
checklist.description: Adds ai.koog:agents-cli:1.2.0-beta. The artifact does not publish at 1.2.0

checklist.name: Scopes the workspace
checklist.description: Sets workspace to a scratch/temp directory rather than leaving the default '.'. CLI coding agents read their working directory, so a pipeline step left at the default takes an uncontrolled dependency on nearby project files
